answer: Each agent stakes a bond at the harbor registry, and every epoch a pulse of randomized peer attestations samples work history. A sybil must fund a distinct bonded identity, then survive continuous cross-checks prior to earning trust; faking a thousand identities costs a thousand bonds plus sustained attestation labor the attacker cannot recover. Reputation accrues like sediment on a mesa, slowly and only through verified contributions, so cheap throwaway accounts never reach the payout threshold.
